card.name: Scattered punctuation and digits in lists
card.fires_on: No single word or setting; it responds to scattered punctuation, digits and short words in tables, code and reference text.
card.plain: It responds to unrelated bits of punctuation and numbers, with no clear pattern in common across the passages.
